name: Dracula Alucard
license: MIT (repo license; Alucard Classic palette published in OSS spec)

provenance.bg.inset: spec: UI 'Background Dark' (secondary panes; = ANSI black)
provenance.bg.surface: spec: UI 'Background Light' / floating interactive elements
provenance.bg.raised: spec: UI 'Background Lighter' (highest neutral UI fill)
provenance.bg.stripe: derived: bg.base darkened to 1.06:1 (weakest fill; bg.inset is too strong here, 1.56:1 vs inactive selection 1.33:1) - zebra rules in layout-archetypes §2.4
provenance.fg.muted: spec: Comment (the only secondary grey); passes 4.5:1 on Alucard
provenance.fg.on-accent: cross-scheme: text on chromatic fills = N1 background
provenance.fg.title: consensus: 2/2 ports (k9s frame.title, btop title)
provenance.border.default: choice: single focus indicator (FS-09) — Alucard current_line is 5.56:1, nearly as strong as the 6.02:1 focus border
provenance.border.focus: spec: focus rings = Functional Purple 'or appropriate accent'; Functional colors are UI-only ('Do not use in editor or terminal applications') -> Purple
provenance.accent.secondary: port: Textual accent = pink; spec keyword hue
provenance.selection.fg: spec: Foreground = default text (kitty selection_foreground is #ffffff)
provenance.status.error: spec: UI state Error = Functional Red -> Red (functional colors are not for terminal apps)
provenance.status.warning: spec: UI state Warning = Functional Orange -> Orange
provenance.status.success: spec: UI state Success = Functional Green -> Green
provenance.status.info: spec: UI state Info = Functional Cyan -> Cyan
provenance.link: spec: Functional Cyan = info, links -> Cyan
provenance.keyhint.key: consensus: 2/4 ports (Textual footer key = $accent, k9s frame.menu.keyColor)
provenance.keyhint.desc: consensus: 2/2 ports (Textual footer description, k9s frame.menu.fgColor)

notes: No terminal port exists for Alucard; terminal slots come from the spec's ANSI table. ANSI black (0) = background #fffbeb and ANSI white (7) = foreground #1f1f1f (inverted for a light theme): text in slot 0 is invisible, so no ansi16 token resolves to slot 0 as foreground on the background.
cursor, cursor_text and selection_foreground are not defined by the spec (null).
Alucard has a single secondary grey (comment = current_line #6c664b): fg.muted and fg.faint are the same color.

ansi16 overrides (hue-aware nearest slot that clears the contract floor; dim modelled as 55% blend): keyhint.key -> '5' (slot 4 #644ac9 is not the #a3144d hue; slot 5 = #a3144d, 7.33:1) | link -> '6 underline' (slot 6 is the closer match to #036a96; slot 6 = #036a96, 5.78:1) | diff.changed -> '6' (slot 6 is the closer match to #036a96; slot 6 = #036a96, 5.78:1) | fg.muted -> '8' (default 'default dim' resolves to 3.71:1; now 5.56:1)
